entry.title: HakobSargsyan/krispwork-outbound-takehome: A lightweight MCP server built on top of a sample leads CSV for AI-driven outbound sales. It exposes two tools: `find_leads` to filter prospects using Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) criteria, and `draft_email` to generate a personalized first-touch email for a selected lead. Email generation is draft-only, with no sending functionality.

It exposes two tools: `find_leads` to filter prospects using Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) criteria, and `draft_email` to generate a personalized first-touch email for a selected lead. Email generation is draft-only, with no sending functionality.

entry.title: Djwalker420/PhantomPad: PhantomPad is a weekend side-project that turns your smartphone into a wireless PC game controller. It uses a lightweight Node.js server and WebSockets to transmit multi-touch inputs over local Wi-Fi. By integrating with the ViGEmBus driver, it authentically emulates a real Xbox 360 controller with zero latency and full joystick support!

entry.title: jpeckenpaugh/nexttext: nexttext is a lightweight Python toolkit for neutralizing explicit gendered terms in text. Via simple, fast heuristics it helps clean and standardize AI-generated labels, reducing model-induced misgendering and other unwanted linguistic artifacts. It's intended for use in AI pipelines, for both processing training data or filtering model outputs.
